about_short_description.short_description: Soldo is a multi-user expense account helping companies manage their budgets.

product.name: Soldo Spend Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for controlling, allocating, tracking, and reporting company spending across teams, departments, entities, and budgets.

product.name: Soldo Company Cards and Payments
product.description: Physical, virtual, prepaid, debit, fuel, and payment-card products plus bank transfers for controlled business spending and supplier or operational payments.

identifier.value: Soldo Expense and Travel & Entertainment Management

product.name: Soldo Expense and Travel & Entertainment Management
product.description: Tools for managing employee expenses and travel spending through approvals, receipt capture, categorization, policy controls, and real-time expense visibility.

product.name: Soldo Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for employees and managers to request funds, check balances, capture receipts, track transactions, and submit expense information while on the go.

product.name: Soldo Integrations and APIs
product.description: Connectors and developer interfaces that synchronize Soldo spending data with accounting, ERP, HR, travel, eCommerce, and other business systems.

product.name: Soldo Professional Services
product.description: Implementation and customization services covering account setup, configuration, custom reporting, onboarding, and bespoke integrations.
